title: Mazu off to The Meteorite
excerpt: The evergreen sprinter is the third horse to be confirmed for this year’s race at Southside Cranbourne
content:
Evergreen sprinter Mazu is the third horse to be confirmed for The Meteorite at Southside Cranbourne this year.

The Triple Crown Syndications-owned Mazu will represent Sports Entertainment Group (SEG) in the $1 million slot race, which will be run over 1200 metres on November 21.

Mazu joins Smooth Chino (Moonee Valley Racing Club) and Jenni The Fox (Cape Schanck Racing) in the 1200-metre sprint, which was won last year by the Cindy Alderson-trained Jigsaw.

Following a gusty second behind Smooth Chino in the G2 McEwen Stakes at his final run for Joe Pride, Mazu was transferred to Ciaron Maher. The eight-year-old made his debut for Victoria’s premier trainer in the Group 1 Champions Sprint at Flemington last Saturday, where he finished ninth, 6.8 lengths from the winner, Point Barrow.

“We are very excited to announce that Triple Crown and Mazu have joined up with the Sports Entertainment Group (SEG), plus all the Giddy Up team for the Southside Meteorite slot race,” Triple Crown’s founder and director, Chris Ward, said on SEN’s Giddy Up With Gareth Hall.

“He still has a lot of talent, winning The Shorts first-up and he just got pipped by Smooth Chino at Flemington down the straight there.

“He is a quirky character, he loves to do things his own way, he loves pulling out some pre-race antics.

“But once you get him out to the track, he is as happy as Larry, he absolutely loves it.”

Mazu has amassed $11.5 in prizemoney, having won nine Stakes races, including the 2022 G1 Doomben 10,000.
